statement: Source dated 2024-12-31 reports: 1981–2010 drought mapping identifies the Danube corridor and central north to the Pre-Balkans; Northeast Bulgaria/Dobrudzha is most affected, with pockets around Blagoevgrad, Petrich–Sandanski and Mesta valley.
compact_statement: Source dated 2024-12-31 reports: 1981–2010 drought mapping identifies the Danube corridor and central north to the Pre-Balkans; Northeast Bulgaria/Dobrudzha is most affected, with pockets around Blagoevgrad, Petrich–Sandanski and Mesta valley.
geographies: central northern Bulgaria to the Pre-Balkans

statement: Source dated 2024-12-31 reports: Struma valley near Kresna Gorge is hottest: some years had 6–8 days above 40°C; 1961–2020 records show 40–55 hot days/year there versus 2–3 on the northern Black Sea coast.
compact_statement: Source dated 2024-12-31 reports: Struma valley near Kresna Gorge is hottest: some years had 6–8 days above 40°C; 1961–2020 records show 40–55 hot days/year there versus 2–3 on the northern Black Sea coast.
geographies: Struma River valley near Kresna Gorge
uncertainty: Historical regional averages, not household exposure.

statement: Source dated 2024-12-31 reports: BTR projects lower precipitation in southern and southeastern Bulgaria under SSP5-8.5 in the far future, potentially compounding hotter conditions.
compact_statement: Source dated 2024-12-31 reports: BTR projects lower precipitation in southern and southeastern Bulgaria under SSP5-8.5 in the far future, potentially compounding hotter conditions.
scenario: SSP5-8.5, far future as labeled in the report.

statement: Source dated 2021-03 reports: For the June 2014 torrential-rain flash flood in Asparuhovo (Varna), the WB box reports 122 evacuated families, Roma ownership of 60% of destroyed houses, and 14 deaths, most among Roma.
compact_statement: Source dated 2021-03 reports: For the June 2014 torrential-rain flash flood in Asparuhovo (Varna), the WB box reports 122 evacuated families, Roma ownership of 60% of destroyed houses, and 14 deaths, most among Roma.
uncertainty: Single historical case; WB-reported casualty count was not reconciled with other reports.

statement: Source dated 2021-03 reports: The report links unequal flood losses in Asparuhovo to informal Roma housing that failed building-code/zoning standards and to inadequate municipal prevention; it says no clear data show how many Roma live in flood-prone areas.
compact_statement: Source dated 2021-03 reports: The report links unequal flood losses in Asparuhovo to informal Roma housing that failed building-code/zoning standards and to inadequate municipal prevention; it says no clear data show how many Roma live in flood-prone areas.
uncertainty: Regional synthesis relies on cited secondary references.

statement: Source dated 2025-12-03 reports: NSI records 38 2024 disaster declarations, mainly for wildfires, floods, drought and hail; declarations for drinking-water shortage due to drought increased from 2023.
compact_statement: Source dated 2025-12-03 reports: NSI records 38 2024 disaster declarations, mainly for wildfires, floods, drought and hail; declarations for drinking-water shortage due to drought increased from 2023.
affected_groups: residents of municipalities under disaster declaration
uncertainty: NSI gives no climate attribution; categories are mixed-hazard.

statement: Source dated 2025-12-03 reports: 2024 declared disasters partly or fully affected 47 municipalities in 19 administrative regions; those municipalities had 1,308,715 residents, 20.3% of Bulgaria's population.
compact_statement: Source dated 2025-12-03 reports: 2024 declared disasters partly or fully affected 47 municipalities in 19 administrative regions; those municipalities had 1,308,715 residents, 20.3% of Bulgaria's population.
geographies: 47 municipalities across 19 administrative regions; names not enumerated in the release text
affected_groups: residents of municipalities partly or fully under disaster declaration
uncertainty: Resident totals are not counts of directly harmed people.

statement: The March 2026 MOEW summary reports high water-network loss indicators for Shumen, Pernik, Targovishte, Haskovo, Yambol and Pazardzhik. These service-system losses are not attributed to climate change; underlying operator periods vary.

statement: Source dated 2026-03 reports: MOEW says small and peripheral settlements are particularly vulnerable to restrictions, low pressure and interruptions; only 1,869 of 5,302 meter zones have continuous flow/pressure measurement with data archiving.
compact_statement: Source dated 2026-03 reports: MOEW says small and peripheral settlements are particularly vulnerable to restrictions, low pressure and interruptions; only 1,869 of 5,302 meter zones have continuous flow/pressure measurement with data archiving.

statement: Source dated 2026-03 reports: In 2024, Irrigation Systems supplied 342,614 decares against 5.376 million decares of design capacity (about 6.4%); MOEW says long-term decline limits agricultural production and increases drought vulnerability.

statement: Source dated 2026-03 reports: MOEW says climate change amplifies, but does not fully explain, water stress; underinvestment, fragmented responsibility, weak expertise and data gaps also contribute. It recommends monitoring, modernization, river/flood planning and local water retention.
